High-performing iron phosphate for enhanced lithium ion solid state batteries as grown by atomic layer deposition

figures.caption: Fig. 1 Growth rate per supercycle of 1 : 1 pulsing of Fe : P, as a function of the pulsing times of (a) Fe(thd)3 and O3 and (b) Me3PO4 and (H2O + O3), based on ellipsometry measurements.

Fig. 2 Growth rate per subcycle and composition of deposited /uniFB01 lms as a function of deposition temperature for a pulsing ratio of 1 : 1 between Fe and P as measured by XRR and XRF, respectively.
Fig. 3 Growth rate per subcycle and composition as a function of the percentage of Fe-subcycles as measured by XRR and XRF, respectively.
Fig. 4 Film thickness and density measured by XRR as a function of the number of supercycles with 3 : 2 pulsing between Fe and P.
